review_method: Independent AI semantic review against the synthetic inputs, current product capabilities, and financial rules; not the model's self-rated confidence or HTTP status
scope: Four targeted live regression cases only; not a complete smoke or Beta readiness verdict

cases.evidence: 本周期剩余可支出 7000 元；消费支出 8000 元，浪费支出 500 元，投资支出 5000 元
cases.reason: The answer correctly reports remaining spendable funds and separate spending categories, without comparing the remainder with historical spending to infer overspending.
cases.wording_note: 数据当前完整 overstates readiness=ready. Prefer 当前没有待核对记录; the snapshot does not establish that all real-world financial data is complete.

cases.evidence: 投资账户合计市值为 117107.09 元。但摘要没有按基金、ETF 等分类拆分
cases.reason: The answer distinguishes total investment-account market value from unavailable product-level totals and no longer asks the user to create tags or enable unsupported functionality.
cases.wording_note: The next action 确认基金和 ETF 的分类记录 retains ambiguous classification wording. Prefer 核对投资账户记录; existing-account review is the supported action.

cases.evidence: 根据当前记录，累计净投入投资账户为105000。
cases.reason: The requested net-contribution amount is correct. The earlier unsupported claim excluding all account transfers is absent. No unsupported next action is suggested.

evidence: 账本中只有本期数据，没有上个周期的记录
查看账本中上个周期的消费、浪费和投资记录
cases.reason: The input contains only the current snapshot and no prior-period data. That supports an inability to compare this request, not a claim that the whole ledger has no historical records. The next action also asks to view the very records the answer says do not exist.
cases.expected_correction: 本次收到的摘要没有上个周期的数据，暂时无法比较变化。
cases.regression_status: A subsequent prompt correction is prepared locally; its live end-to-end result has not been verified by this review.
